mapper.select: SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name='RN-04' AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
SELECT run_id FROM task_active_run WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND task_id=#{taskId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT response_ref FROM operation_record WHERE operation_name='RN-04' AND target_id=#{runId} AND state='COMPLETED' AND response_ref->>'$.data.run.status'='CANCEL_REQUESTED' AND response_ref->>'$.data.command_id' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at,operation_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE task_head SET status='CANCEL_REQUESTED',revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND revision=#{taskRevision}

UPDATE stream_registry SET last_sequence=#{nextSequence},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND stream_id=#{streamId} AND kind='RUN' AND owner_resource_id=#{runId} AND last_sequence=#{sequence}
